messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: GPU pool hosted-usw2-gpu-3 saturation 96% · queue length 420 · admission-control ACTIVE · see https://dash.redwood/hosted/usw2/pool/3

samir: seeing huge burst across /chat + /embeddings routes. 99p latencies climbing, queueing dominated by many short requests. no obvious node crashes.

jia: are these long-running streaming sessions or tiny generation calls?

samir: mostly small generations (<=256 tokens) from a handful of customers. RPS ~2100, pool capacity ~=1800. admission_control started dropping after 30s wait window.

maria: posting dashboard snap: https://img.redwood/dash/1795234000.png — heatmap shows sustained saturation on GPUs 12-19 in the pool.

leo: any network error spikes? I checked fabric metrics — packet loss normal, no AZ flaps. looks compute-bound.

jess: runtime logs show repeated "kvcache memory pressure" messages on 3 hosts. KV cache hit rate fell ~15% which explains perf regression for short requests.

samir: mitigation suggestions: 1) enable burst_pool for hosted-usw2 (adds 2x spot-backed nodes for 15m) 2) route non-critical embeddings traffic to eu1 fallback 3) increase admission grace to 45s temporarily?

jia: what's cost of burst_pool if sustained: rough ballpark +$4k/day. OK for short blips but not sustained.

maria: ops note: if this persists >30m we should spin dedicated warm nodes and inform sales/account teams about potential customer impact.

leo: can we hotpatch routing policy to prefer eu1 for embedding routes? small change to match by route tag. sample: `routePolicy.update({match: {tag: 'embeddings'}, fallback: ['eu1'], priority: 'latency_cost'})`

ops-runner: running canary apply: `infractl routing push --policy usw2-fallback-canary` -> canary on 3 hosts now, ETA 2m.

samir: also asking runtime: jess, can we bump prefix cache TTL for chat-retention routes 5m -> 30m to cut token counts? should reduce load on KV and GPUs for repeated prompts.

jess: I can flip prefix_cache_ttl via feature-flag for those routes. toggling on canary now.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INC-2026-1795234 by samir. Severity: S2 (partial degradation).

maria: monitoring action: set temporary alert thresholds: queue_length > 500 or admission_throttle_rate > 0.2 for 10m -> page eng-infra.

jia: add metric to watch: `kvcache_hit_rate` and `admission_drop_ratio`. if hit_rate < 0.6 we need longer-term KV sizing.

samir: patch notes: applied routing canary + prefix cache TTL canary. observing for 5m then roll if good.

ops-runner: canary applied to 3 hosts at 1795234098. metrics streaming...

samir: 10m update: queue length down from 420 -> 260, admission drop rate down from 0.14 -> 0.05, 99p latency improving.

jess: prefix cache TTL change looks effective on canary, KV pressure easing.

maria: good short-term. long-term action items: investigate KV cache sizing and model placement skew; consider autoscaling policy tweak to allow faster burst capacity or a warm pool reserved for short spikes.

leo: I'll open a follow-up runbook PR to document fallback routing and cost thresholds for burst_pool usage.

samir: thanks everyone — I'll keep monitoring and update if anything else changes. :thumbsup:
